## Generated file inventory

Regenerate: `bun scripts/audit/ui/rust-migration.ts`; validate reproducibility: append `--check`. Git-tracked and unignored new source files are enumerated under `apps/web`, `crates/ui`, `crates/tauri`, `crates/web/site`, `crates/aphrody-webos-wasm`, `m3`, `packages/web`; caches and node_modules are excluded. Generated tracked ui-dist files remain explicit artifact rows.

Current files: **1496**. Retired TS/TSX/JS/HTML/CSS files: **62**, from **65** checkpointed apps/web files at `6f7b0805f9afb0c92dcb18c091960cdb373345dc`. Retired files had no active consumer in the native site launcher or canonical build. Their deletion does not establish Rust frontend parity.

Active app-ui, M3 showcase and Bun WebOS remain TypeScript. Native Rust owns the site HTTP routes and catalogs; the canonical app consumer/build and native public routes are qualified. Rust-only component, rendering and desktop parity remains open. `crates/ui/m3` exists; consult its separate owner's gates. No competing framework is created.

## Actual Bun Rust owners

Configured fork HEAD: `4ff8eb6dd013ef4bc6e96a9e8aec2d4ce5b3e3b6`. Locally verified origin/main ref: `8b63179285763c3c812bedf06465a1167c694f59` (tracking-ref observation, not a remote fetch or a new dependency integration). Use this exact rev only after downstream qualification; no Git dependency was added by this inventory.

Fork toolchain is nightly-2026-09-15 and edition 2024. Direct consumption must qualify the allocator API and generic experimental/nightly feature gates. CSS, HTTP and bundler/JSC boundaries require their own build/link checks against the native Bun engine; manifest existence does not qualify standalone reuse.
